description: Exercises authoritative cargo changes through V3 trading, planet transfer and jettison requests.

tests.name: Setup: Auth user for cargo tests
Rig: Find an existing port outside protected FedSpace

data.sql: SELECT port_id, sector_id FROM ports WHERE sector_id > 10 ORDER BY port_id LIMIT 1

tests.name: Rig: Configure the disposable port's stock and trade rows

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET type = 1, size = 1000, petty_cash = 1000000 WHERE port_id = @{cargo_port_id}

tests.name: Rig: Replace target port commodity directions
Rig: Seed legal and illegal port inventory

data.sql: INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, commodity, mode, maxproduct) VALUES (@{cargo_port_id}, 'ORE', 'sell', 5000), (@{cargo_port_id}, 'ORG', 'sell', 5000), (@{cargo_port_id}, 'EQU', 'sell', 5000), (@{cargo_port_id}, 'SLV', 'sell', 5000)

tests.name: Rig: Seed authoritative port stock

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity, price, last_updated_ts) VALUES ('port', @{cargo_port_id}, 'ORE', 100, 10, 0), ('port', @{cargo_port_id}, 'ORG', 100, 10, 0), ('port', @{cargo_port_id}, 'EQU', 100, 10, 0), ('port', @{cargo_port_id}, 'SLV', 100, 10, 0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity, price = EXCLUDED.price

tests.name: Rig: Clear active ship cargo and legacy cargo columns

data.sql: DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{cargo_test_user_player_id})

tests.name: Rig: Place player and active ship at the port with permitted illegal-trade credentials

data.sql: WITH moved_ship AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{cargo_sector_id}, onplanet = FALSE, ore = 0, organics = 0, equipment = 0, slaves = 0, drugs = 0, weapons = 0, colonists = 0 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{cargo_test_user_player_id}) RETURNING ship_id) UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{cargo_sector_id}, alignment = -501, experience = 100000, credits = 100000 WHERE player_id = @{cargo_test_user_player_id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moved_ship)

tests.name: Rig: Create an owned test planet at the port sector

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, population, type, creator, created_by) VALUES (@{cargo_sector_id}, 'Cargo Test Planet', @{cargo_test_user_player_id}, 'player', 'M', 0, (SELECT planettypes_id FROM planettypes ORDER BY planettypes_id LIMIT 1), 'cargo-regression', @{cargo_test_user_player_id}) RETURNING planet_id

tests.name: Rig: Configure planet ORE storage

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods (planet_id, commodity, quantity, max_capacity, production_rate) VALUES (@{cargo_planet_id}, 'ORE', 0, 1000, 0)

tests.name: Rig: Resolve canonical ORE commodity ID

data.sql: SELECT commodities_id FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE'

tests.name: T1.1: New active ship begins with empty cargo
T1.2: Buy ORE through the V3 port trade contract
T1.3: Ship status confirms persisted ORE cargo
T1.4: Buy a second commodity
T1.5: Ship status exposes mixed cargo
T2.1: Buy an illegal commodity with eligible alignment and experience
T2.2: Ship status confirms illegal cargo
T3.1: Selling more ORE than held is rejected
T3.2: Rejected sale leaves cargo unchanged
T4.1: Buy EQU and verify cargo state
Rig: Configure port to buy EQU from player

data.sql: UPDATE port_trade SET mode = 'buy' WHERE port_id = @{cargo_port_id} AND commodity = 'EQU'

tests.name: T4.2: Sell the EQU back to the port
T4.3: EQU sale removes cargo from the public ship status
T5.1: Land on owned planet before depositing cargo
T5.2: Deposit ORE into the planet
T5.3: Deposit reduces ship ORE cargo
T5.4: Withdraw ORE from the planet
T5.5: Withdraw restores ship ORE cargo
T6.1: Jettison one ORE by canonical commodity ID
T6.2: Jettison removes exactly one ORE from ship status
T7.1: Runtime-added commodity behavior remains deferred
tests.reason: The canonical commodities table and port_trade CHECK constraint permit only the approved V3 commodity codes; runtime ALT insertion is not a supported contract.
